00071 //#define FFTMagnitudeSelection_Docs @param input  The input signal to perform the FFT on, this should be mono  \

00074 //       @param overlap  Overlap factor for the FFT. E.g., if overlap is 2 and FFT size \
00075 //            is 1024, an FFT will be performed every 512 samples. This  \
00076 //            should be a small power of 2 (e.g., 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 etc).  \
00077 //       @param firstBin  The first bin index to report, 0 is the DC bin and the bin at \
00078 //            index equal to the FFT size is the Nyquist bin.     \
00079 //       @param numBins  The number of bins to report. The maximum if firstBin is zero \
00080 //            is equal to one greater than half the FFT size (e.g., if FFT \
00081 //            size is 128 the maximum is 65 assuming firstBin is zero).
00082 */
